status: Gate 3 revision (AQ-034, AQ-035); proposed for owner review
units: second homes on single-family lots per 1,000 one-unit detached homes per year
area_levels: reference/wi_y_by_area.csv (y_lower, y_central, y_upper: market-adjusted California regression, state-relative group rule v1)

lower.basis: Regression lower draw (2.5% statewide total); California Central Valley first-law ramp (year 1 held at 0.10)

central.basis: Regression point prediction; California restrictive-group ramp

upper.basis: Regression upper draw (97.5% statewide total); California middle-group ramp

midwest_local_reform.basis: What permissive local rules produce without a statewide law in Midwest markets (Madison 0.18, Minneapolis 0.17); Madison floor 0.229 everywhere; slow ramp

notes: Uniform 'level' applies only where an area has no regression level. Madison floor = observed 2022-2025 rate 0.183 / 0.8.
